_comment: Template detection by code, not by AI. Rules match the PDF text layer and the file name. Scans have no text layer, so for Summit the file/folder name is usually the only signal - otherwise the human picks the template in the checkpoint app. Edit the patterns to match real TPT files.

Pioneer.notes: Vector PDF from CAD, decimal point, hole table TAG|X LOC|Y LOC|SIZE, symbols diameter/counterbore/countersink/depth (Pioneer-only convention).

Summit.notes: Mostly scans (5 sub-templates A-E). Depth arrow differs from Pioneer, counterbore often drawn as stacked diameters, triangles = surface finish level.
